limitations: Distance scatter and photometric ellipse scatter define illustrative sensitivity alternatives, not posterior draws or distance mean errors.
Flat oblate inclination uses cos(i)^2=((1-e)^2-q0^2)/(1-q0^2); q0 is assumed, not observed.
P5 stellar sky vectors are mapped through the P1 tangent-plane pixel translation; explicit core TAN ignores inherited SIP under prior calibration evidence. No input headers or fluxes change.
Subpixel midpoint integration deposits projected area and signed flux conservatively; full image and finite field/taper losses are recorded.
Stellar nonzero ICA labels and nonfinite values are unobserved; HI released zero values are blanked/nondetections, not empty space; signed CO and positive-error support retained.
Known beams remain embedded; no beam matching or deconvolution is claimed. Source spatial correlations are not measured by this builder.
Both uncovered-zero and coverage-normalized annular fill are conditional alternatives, not confidence bounds. Negative clipping and filled mass are reported.
Thin-disk tracer grids are inputs to a later source reprojection/height ensemble, not a complete 3D reconstruction.
Hot/ionized gas, CO-dark gas, IMF and calibration/excitation variations, bulge/warp/depth and exterior source mass remain uncertain.
HERACLES MOM0 mask uses HI velocity windows; source processing is not independent of all HI kinematics even though this builder reads no velocities.
NGC3198 has inclination about 71.9 degrees under q0=.13; a single flat disk and scalar photometric ellipse cannot establish warp, bulge or depth.
Grid and 24–28 kpc radial taper can exclude real exterior HI/CO. Report full signed input, finite-field loss and taper loss separately; do not call these whole-galaxy masses.

Initial P1 Gaia all-catalog failure is retained. Later finite-footprint strict pass and both P5 relative-transfer receipts support only this development registration; no fresh epoch or absolute photometric calibration.

Historical STELLAR_MASS_MAP filename contains cleaned stellar flux (MJy/sr); ICA mask inherited BUNIT is not physical intensity. Fixed M/L is assumed; fitted transfer scale/background are not applied.
